title: Enable direct Internet SSH access to analytics DMZ workers for vendor support

details.executive_summary: Pre-flight simulation for CHG-NET-2026-3105 concluded with verdict: WARN_MANUAL_REVIEW. Composite risk score: 51/100. Identified 1 security finding(s) across 7 affected asset(s). Manual Review Required: Detected 1 HIGH severity finding(s): [Missing Threat Prevention Profile: Rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public'].

predicted_affected_assets.impact_description: Security policy containing rule(s) 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public' deployed directly onto perimeter firewall
Security rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public' modifies egress filtering for zone 'Untrust-Internet'
Security rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public' modifies egress filtering for zone 'Untrust-Internet'

predicted_affected_assets.asset_name: Subnet: DMZ Public Web & Ingestion Subnet (10.100.4.0/24)

identified_security_gaps.technical_impact: Palo Alto rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public' between ['Untrust-Internet'] and ['Trust-DMZ'] omits or disables security_profile_group ('none'). Traffic flows without deep packet inspection, antivirus, anti-spyware, or WildFire zero-day sandbox analysis.
identified_security_gaps.compliance_violation: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0 (Rule 4.2) & NIST SP 800-171 3.13.1
identified_security_gaps.remediation_guidance: Attach an approved security profile group (e.g. security_profile_group = 'corporate-threat-prevention-standard') to rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public'.

pre_implementation_validation_plan.what_to_validate: Verify App-ID application and threat profile bindings for rule 'Allow-Untrust-Inbound-SSH-Public'
pre_implementation_validation_plan.expected_pass_criteria: Applications must NOT show 'any'; security-profiles must include active profile group

details.safe_remediated_config:
# [REMEDIATED] Palo Alto Security Policy with explicit App-ID and Threat Prevention
resource "panos_security_policy" "remediated_analytics_egress" {
  rule {
    name                  = "Allow-Analytics-Outbound-Webhook-Remediated"
    source_zones          = ["Trust-DMZ"]
    source_addresses      = ["10.100.4.0/24"]
    source_users          = ["any"]
    destination_zones     = ["Untrust-Internet"]
    destination_addresses = ["52.84.120.0/22"] # Scoped to verified partner CIDR
    applications          = ["ssl", "web-browsing"] # Layer 7 App-ID enforced
    services              = ["service-https"]
    action                = "allow"
    security_profile_group = "corporate-threat-prevention-standard"
  }
}
compliance_frameworks: CIS Palo Alto Firewall Benchmark v1.1.0
